mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.9% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.9%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) signals an elevated risk of aggressive monetary tightening, which typically depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 240, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1150 units signals reduced residential construction activity, which typically precedes weaker consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1150, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth is negative and UNRATE rises, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle with high inflation (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 240) typically leads to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with high inflation (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 240)
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 240, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.
